architecture.conventions: Next.js 16 App Router. Routes in src/app/<route>/page.tsx with a sibling layout.tsx for per-route metadata. Presentational components in src/components/sections/<page>/ named after the page they serve; shared primitives in src/components/ui/ (shadcn) and src/components/shared/. Static content in src/data/*.ts (projects.ts is the single source of truth for projects). Cross-cutting logic in src/lib/, grouped by concern: content/ (MDX loader + Zod schema), config/, canvas/, actions/, types/. Hooks in src/hooks/. MDX posts in content/posts/*.mdx, validated by scripts/check-post.mjs before publish.

rules.components: PascalCase .tsx files, one component per file, named after the export
rules.modules: kebab-case .ts files in src/lib and src/data (e.g. spacing-standards.ts, github-stats.ts)
rules.routes: lowercase App Router segments, [slug] for dynamic
rules.posts: kebab-case .mdx slugs describing the specific problem

pr.standards: Imperative-mood commit subjects, sentence case, no scope prefixes and no trailing period (e.g. "Add a section param to the OG route and a Polaris project image"). Bodies explain why the change was made and what it fixes, in prose or a short labelled list, wrapped near 76 columns. No AI attribution: never add Co-Authored-By or Generated-with trailers to commits or PR bodies. Work lands on main.
